## Composite: subtree cluster matrices (A, B) + disagreeing genotype trees (C, D, E, F)
```{r composite}
# read TIFF, trim its own whitespace border, -> raster
read_trimmed<-function(img_path){
  magick::image_trim(magick::image_read(img_path))
}

# native width/height aspect ratio (post-trim), used to size panels so images aren't stretched
img_aspect<-function(img){
  info<-magick::image_info(img)
  info$width[1]/info$height[1]
}

# label strip (top) + image (below), stacked so the bold panel label never
# overlaps the image's own top content (axis labels / column names)
label_panel<-function(img,label,label.frac=0.05){
  strip<-ggdraw()+draw_label(label,fontface="bold",size=14,x=0.01,hjust=0)
  panel<-ggdraw()+draw_image(as.raster(img),x=0,y=0,width=1,height=1)+theme_void()
  plot_grid(strip,panel,ncol=1,rel_heights=c(label.frac,1-label.frac))
}

files<-c(f.a,f.b,f.c,f.d,f.e,f.f)
missing<-files[!file_exists(files)]
if(length(missing)>0)stop("Missing input file(s):\n",paste(missing,collapse="\n"))

labels<-c(
  "A) Genoflu vs. TreeCluster","C) GenoFlu D1.1","D) GenoFlu B3.13",
  "B) Genin2 vs. TreeCluster","E) Genin2 EA-2020-C","F) Genin2 EA-2020-C"
)

imgs<-map(files,read_trimmed)
panels<-map2(imgs,labels,label_panel)

# shared column widths so rows line up: matrix col sized to the
# average of the two matrices' native aspect ratios (they differ slightly),
# tree cols sized to the trees' shared native aspect ratio
w.matrix<-mean(c(img_aspect(imgs[[1]]),img_aspect(imgs[[4]])))
w.tree<-img_aspect(imgs[[2]])
rel.widths<-c(w.matrix,w.tree,w.tree)

composite<-plot_grid(
  plotlist=panels,
  nrow=2,ncol=3,byrow=TRUE,
  rel_widths=rel.widths,rel_heights=c(1.4,1)
)

# 450 dpi in png, tiff, and pdf (pdf embeds the panel rasters at native resolution)
for(ext in c("png","tiff","pdf")){
  out.file<-path(f.out,paste0("composite_subtree_geno.",ext))
  if(ext=="tiff"){
    ggsave(out.file,composite,width=20,height=13*1.1,dpi=450,bg="white",compression="lzw")
  }else{
    ggsave(out.file,composite,width=20,height=13*1.1,dpi=450,bg="white")
  }
  message("Wrote: ",out.file)
}
```
